config.swap_retract_length_hint: Toolhead → Y-splitter distance. Empty = default 900. 0 = legacy full retract.
config.fa_load_disable: Disable feed-assist / ACE feed during load
config.identity_priority_hint: What happens on a head the firmware has flagged as an official spool - a genuine RFID spool, or SpoolLink stamping one to lock the display. "multiACE decides" forces our identity through on ACE-driven heads: on those, our identity is what actually prints, and SpoolLink cannot bind an ACE slot anyway (it needs the RFID card UID, which no slot reports). That clears the official flag, and the Spoolman binding with it once the filament really changed. "Leave SpoolLink alone" keeps out of such heads - the binding survives, the display can show the wrong material after a swap. Feeder and manual heads are never touched either way.
config.mode_change_pending: Klipper restart required to apply mode change
config.mode_locked_msg: Unload all toolheads first to switch to or from Normal mode. Still loaded: {heads}.
config.update_intro: Pulls the latest multiACE release and installs it.
config.update_apply_msg: Downloads and installs {to} (currently: {from}). Klipper restarts afterwards. Make sure no print is running first.
config.debug_explain: Updates only survive the next reboot once persistent updates are enabled. To enable, run the command below over SSH and reboot.
config.debug_apply_locked_tip: Enable persistent updates first, otherwise this install gets wiped on the next reboot.
config.debug_disable_msg: Removes /oem/.debug. The next reboot will wipe /oem/overlay/upper - installed updates revert to whatever is baked into the firmware image. Use this to roll back a bad install.
config.debug_reboot_prompt: Debug mode is now ENABLED. Reboot once so the overlay-wipe is skipped from now on.
config.debug_reboot_msg: Sends /machine/reboot to Moonraker. Any running job is aborted.
config.head_mode_hint: Head mode: each head is ACE-driven by default. Toggle individual heads to "Feeder" on the dashboard to hand them to their stock side feeder.
config.pickup_cleaning_label: Wipe the nozzle after tool pickups that have no cleaning move
config.pickup_cleaning_hint: Experimental: after a same-colour tool pickup with no swap/flush, a short nozzle wipe at the discard position removes the parked head's ooze thread (real swaps and background arrivals already wipe). Costs a discard excursion per pickup; applies to the next preflighted print.
config.fluidd_panel_add: Add as a camera in Fluidd
config.fluidd_panel_added: Added - open Fluidd and show the camera card.
config.fluidd_panel_hint: Registers the compact panel as an "HTTP Page" camera, so it appears on the Fluidd dashboard. An entry of the same name is left alone, so your own adjustments survive a second click.
config.tipform_intro: Replaces ONLY the pull moves of the filament tip forming - discard position, heating, ooze scrape-off and nozzle cleaning stay stock. 'stock' keeps the firmware behaviour; 'custom' uses the tables below (key = filament type as declared on the slot; 'default' applies to everything without its own table, 'soft' to flexible filament). Tables are validated before saving - an invalid table is rejected here instead of halting Klipper. Changes apply after a Klipper restart.
config.tipform_stock_hint: Insert the firmware's stock pull as a starting point
config.tipform_err_name: Every table needs a name (the filament type, e.g. petg).
config.tipform_restart_pending: The saved configuration differs from what Klipper is running - restart Klipper to apply.
config.tipform_syntax: Tokens: <mm>@<feedrate> (extruder move, negative = retract, mm/min) - pause:<ms> - temp:<C> (set, no wait) - waittemp:<C> (set + wait, both directions; below 175 no further moves allowed - Klipper min_extrude_temp; slow in background swaps) - fan:<0-255> (inline only) - unloadtemp:<C> (unload/tip-form temp for this material/vendor, default 250; may be a table's only content = stock pull at that temp). A table must end with a net retract. The background swap uses the same tables.
config.tipform_unsupported: This multiACE build has no tip-forming module - update multiACE first.

msg.pause_swap_slot_empty: [multiACE] Slot empty for Head {head} (ACE {ace} / Slot {slot}) - load filament, then RESUME
msg.pause_swap_slot_empty_post: [multiACE] Slot empty for Head {head} (ACE {ace} / Slot {slot}) after unload - load filament, then RESUME
msg.pause_bg_pick_no_flow: [multiACE] Pick check on Head {head}: no filament flow detected after the background load - check the head/nozzle, reload if needed (display/web), then RESUME
msg.pause_swap_unload_jam: [multiACE] Unload jam on Head {head} - unload ACE{ua}/Slot{us}, load ACE{la}/Slot{ls}, then RESUME
msg.pause_swap_load_slip: [multiACE] Load slip on Head {head} (ACE {ace} / Slot {slot}) - unload, reload, then RESUME
msg.pause_swap_load_no_transport: [multiACE] Load failed on Head {head} (ACE {ace} / Slot {slot}): filament never reached the toolhead (NO TRANSPORT) - check spool / bowden / ACE path, then unload, reload, RESUME
msg.pause_swap_load_no_flow: [multiACE] Load failed on Head {head} (ACE {ace} / Slot {slot}): filament arrived but the nozzle does not extrude (NO FLOW) - check the nozzle for a clog; unload+reload alone will not fix a clog. Then RESUME
msg.pause_feed_load_jam: [multiACE] Load jam on Head {head}{loc} - reload via display/web, then RESUME
msg.pause_feed_error: [multiACE] Feed error on Head {head}{loc} - check filament, then RESUME
msg.pause_manual_feed_error: [multiACE] Manual feed error on Head {head}{loc} - check filament, then retry
msg.pause_runout: [multiACE] Runout on Head {head}{loc} - reload filament, then RESUME
msg.pause_ace_comms_lost: [multiACE] ACE {ace} comms lost (Head {head}) - check USB/power, then RESUME
msg.head_manual_loaded: [multiACE] Head {head} still has filament loaded - unload it first to change manual mode
msg.feed_manual_skip: [multiACE] Head {head} is manual - load/unload by hand, ACE feed skipped
msg.unload_head_already_empty: [multiACE] Head {head} is already empty - nothing to unload
msg.no_devices_after_wait: Found {count} of {expected} ACE devices after waiting; continuing - connect more by reconnecting them.
msg.feed_assist_disarmed: Feed assist disarmed on ACE {ace} slot {slot}
msg.feed_assist_armed: Feed assist armed on ACE {ace} slot {slot}
msg.usb_unstable: [multiACE] USB unstable, expected {expected} ACEs, found {count} - ACE inactive, Klipper continues. FIRMWARE_RESTART required after reconnecting.
msg.all_expected_found: [multiACE] All {expected} expected ACE device(s) found, canonical mapping locked
msg.no_ace_serial_configured: [multiACE] No ACE devices found and no serial configured - ACE inactive, Klipper continues
msg.open_ace_failed_attempts: [multiACE] Failed to open ACE {ace} at startup after {attempts} attempts
msg.not_all_aces_opened: [multiACE] Not all ACEs opened at startup - continuing with partial set
msg.print_start_head_needs_unavailable: [multiACE] WARNING: Head {head} needs ACE {ace} but only {count} ACE(s) available!
msg.print_start_head_needs_disconnected: [multiACE] WARNING: Head {head} needs ACE {ace} which is not connected!
msg.ghost_heads: [multiACE] GHOST HEAD(S): {heads} have filament at the toolhead sensor but no head_source mapping. ACE_SWAP_HEAD will be refused for these heads. Recover: ACEC__Unload_All then ACEB__Load_N for each affected head, then restart the print.
msg.head_source_inconsistent: [multiACE] PRINT ABORTED: inconsistent slot mapping ({detail}). The saved head/slot configuration is corrupt (a head is mapped to a slot that is not its own, or two heads share one slot). Recover: ACEC__Unload_All, then run ACE_CLEAR_HEADS, then restart the print.
msg.print_start_fa_enabled: [multiACE] Print start: feed_assist enabled on ACE {ace} slot {slot} (head {head})
msg.cascade_detected: [multiACE] CASCADE detected: {count} ACEs failed in <1.5s (total cascades this session: {total})
msg.serial_write_recovered: [multiACE] ACE {ace} serial write recovered after reconnect
msg.fa_failed_final: [multiACE] FA start_feed_assist FAILED after {attempts} attempt(s) on ACE {ace} slot {slot}: code={code} msg={msg} - this lane will NOT be fed; check that filament is loaded into the ACE slot
msg.fa_failed_pause: [multiACE] Feed-assist could not be armed on ACE {ace} slot {slot} ({attempts} attempts) - head {head} would print without feed (ACE 2 cannot freewheel). Print PAUSED; fix the ACE (jam/busy/filament) and RESUME to retry
msg.load_refused_auto_mode: [multiACE] Load head {head}: the stock feed channel REFUSED the load - per-port automatic feeding (touchscreen AutoLoad) for this head's port is OFF, so the load was silently skipped and NO filament was fed. Enable AutoLoad for this port on the touchscreen, then retry
msg.load_not_finished: [multiACE] Load head {head}: the feed channel did not run the load (state={state}) - filament did NOT reach the head; aborting instead of continuing dry
msg.bg_pick_no_flow_pause: [multiACE] Head {head}: the background load could not be verified - NO flow at the nozzle even after a re-grip. Print PAUSED before printing dry; check nozzle/filament, purge manually, then RESUME
msg.bg_pick_absent_pause: [multiACE] Head {head}: marked loaded by the background swap but the toolhead sensor reads NO filament. Print PAUSED; load the head manually, then RESUME
msg.ace_stuck_powercycle: [multiACE] ACE {ace} stuck in status={status} after {attempts} reconnect attempts - aborting operation. Power-cycle the ACE.
msg.ace_wait_busy_feeding: [multiACE] ACE {ace} busy with a slot feeding/rollback (e.g. an inserted spool's pre-load) - waiting for it to finish ({attempt}/{max}), not a hang
msg.switch_in_progress: [multiACE] ACE switch already in progress, please wait
msg.ace_already_active_loading: [multiACE] ACE {ace} already active, loading available filaments...
msg.switch_extruder_full_unload: [multiACE] Extruder {head}: filament in head, full unload
msg.switch_extruder_skip_unload: [multiACE] Extruder {head}: not in head, skipping unload

msg.switch_extruder_already_loaded: [multiACE] Extruder {head}: filament already in head, skipping
msg.switch_extruder_no_filament: [multiACE] Extruder {head}: no filament in ACE, skipping
msg.ace_out_of_range_for_head: [multiACE] ACE {ace} out of range for head {head}
msg.load_head_already_loaded: [multiACE] Head {head} already has filament loaded. Unload first.
msg.load_head_inferred_only_ace: [multiACE] Head {head} already loaded, mapped to the only connected ACE / Slot {slot}
msg.load_head_no_source_recorded: [multiACE] Head {head} has filament but no head_source recorded. With {count} ACEs connected the source cannot be inferred safely. Run Unload All to clear all heads, then load fresh.
msg.load_slot_no_filament: [multiACE] ACE {ace} / Slot {slot} has no filament! Aborting load.
msg.unload_sensor_no_filament: [multiACE] Note: Sensor on head {head} not detecting filament (may be stationary)
msg.unload_head_no_mapping: [multiACE] Unloading head {head} (no ACE mapping, using active ACE)...
msg.unload_filament_still_detected: [multiACE] Warning: Filament still detected in head {head} after unload!
msg.test_cancelled: [multiACE] TEST CANCELLED by user - stopping after step {step}
msg.test_cancel_requested: [multiACE] TEST cancel requested - stopping after current step

msg.unload_gate_empty: [multiACE] Head {head}: ACE {ace} / Slot {slot} reports EMPTY while the toolhead still holds filament - it likely ran out or broke ABOVE the ACE gate. The machine cannot retract it (the tail is out of the ACE gears): heat the head, open the bowden coupling at the toolhead and pull the filament out by hand, then reload the slot.
